notes.title: Razer Chroma Devices Fix for some Computers
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6152172/a1a9969a574d520a7d10dd9529d47f7aa0c51df3.png[/img]
Here is a work around that has shown success if you are having trouble getting the Chroma devices to work properly within DubWars. 

1. Start the Services app on your computer
2. Locate Razer Chroma SDK Service, Right Click and select Start
3. Inside DubWars access the settings menu from the main screen
4. Check that the Chroma Setting is set to On

Another thing to check is that your Razer Synapse app is up to date and DubWars is configured to be enabled.

Let us know if you are still having any problems and we will work with you. Visit our website at www.dubwars.com and send us a message through the support tab.

notes.title: Bug Fixes - 8/10/16
notes.notes:
We have made some updates and fixes to the game. Please let us know if any of your problems related to the issues below are still happening.

+ Restored achievement unlocking, your achievements should now fully sync to Steam. This includes already unlocked achievements.
+ Fixed the splash screen not showing logos on Mac and Linux.
+ Updates to internal SDKs for better performance.

If you have any issues please don't hesitate to contact our support team here: [url=http://www.dubwars.com/support]DubWars Support[/url]

notes.title: DubWars Summer 2016 Release Announced!
notes.notes:
DubWars is officially scheduled for release in Summer 2016!

We want to thank everyone for helping us get to this final step in our journey to bring you one of the most unique games to ever be made. Through your help, feedback, and support we are putting the final touches on DubWars that will make it better than ever before, and be ready for a full-scale launch!

Many of you have helped us financially with our Early Access, so we wanted to explain to you why we won't be updating that version. We feel it is a better use of time and resources to go straight for an official launch.

You certainly won't be left in the dark though! Our last stretch before release will be filled with interactions with our ever-growing community. We've got Dev Diaries, Teasers, Trailers, Let's Plays, and other events to show off what DubWars will look like when released.

The development team is really excited to share with you DubWars like you've never seen or heard it before. Get ready for Summer 2016!

For more information, visit us on our social media!
https://www.facebook.com/DubWars/
https://twitter.com/DubWarsGame/
https://www.reddit.com/r/dubwars

notes.title: Status Update
notes.notes:
DubWars is coming together and we wanted to give an update on where we are. 

Big thank you to the community for all of the feedback and suggestions! 

We have made some great strides towards bringing the true vision to life and can't wait to surprise everyone. 
[olist]
[*]One of the biggest changes upcoming is the size of each level. The maps have been increased to allow for more playable area. The player and enemies have been enlarged as well. 

[*]The enemies and levels have had further iterations and design improvements. 

[*]The VFX have come a long way and really sizzle with the music. 
[/olist]
While we were hoping to have development finished sooner, the game is just not ready. Our commitment to deliver the best experience possible is what drives us.

notes.title: DubWars v0.3.3 is live
notes.notes:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/gY7hJ1F.png[/img]
[b]This is our last planned major update for the rest of the year. Our team is dedicated to finishing development by the end of December. We thank everyone who participated in providing feedback. Starting in January we will be adding Steam features and preparing for an official release![/b] 

[b]Latest changes in this update:[/b] 
[list]
[*]Chroma device support has been added. Currently MTRD and Urban Metaphor have been synced to light up with player weapons. We are excited to offer a more immersive experience. Let us know what you think!
[*]Level select Nexus now has icons and effects to help show progression. As new levels are unlocked, icons have been added to help clarify which new level is now available. A glow effect around levels now activates when new difficulty modes are available. These are very rough and will be updated in future updates.
[*]On a few levels that contain multiple paths to unlock levels, we have added some portals to help facilitate where your ship should be. The only exception being Break It Up, as choosing your team color dictates the outcome. 
[*]Fixed the player ship moving off of the screen.
[/list]
Known bugs:
[list]
[*]Linux - [b]DO NOT BUY YET.[/b] Adding this option has caused more complication than we anticipated. It does work on our machines, but have reports from others that either levels will not load or enemies will not spawn. Ubuntu has shown the most success, so far. We have decided to focus on finishing development of DubWars and will revisit Linux versions in January.  
[/list]
Upcoming:
[list]
[*]Achievements & Objectives - level and game wide challenges will be added with accompanying ship bonuses. 
[*]Ship Hangar - Ships will be earned and unlocked through achievements.
[*]Leaderboards - Compare scores with friends and enemies. 
[/list]

notes.title: DubWars v0.3.2 is live
notes.notes:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/YOBBbNQ.png[/img]

[b]Thank you for all the recent comments and reviews! We are very pleased with the wonderful reception to the September update, along with the engaged feedback on squashing bugs.[/b] 

[b]Latest changes in this update:[/b] 
[list]
[*]Gameplay changes throughout all 10 levels - Most notably on Choose Your Weapon (more challenging) and Distorted (enemies will actually die now). The rest of the levels have a better balance of enemy health to player weapon damage. We implemented a base system that will allow for better refinement over time.
[*]New Menu System Design - We received a lot of comments on the previous layout. So we cleaned it up, with the biggest improvement being the weapons upgrade system. Now you can upgrade entire weapon groups and the weapon icons are more clear to help understand what you are upgrading. 
[*]MTRD - Fixed one of the stream weapons that was acting up after upgrading.
[*]Eclipse - The baby spiders are now moving towards the player appropriately. This allows for easier dodging of those enemies. 
[*]Choose Your Weapon - Improved the visibility on the ice shards. These will slow your ship speed. So you should have an easier time seeing them now.
[*]Metalworks - Scan beam weapon is now working properly. It will pull in sound currency to your ship and also deal some damage to enemies. 
[*]Break It Up - Fixed an issue of switching teams when using Play Again and not being able to destroy enemies.
[*]Menu system is more controller friendly. 
[*]Fixed an issue in some levels where your ship would not die. 
[/list]
Known bugs:
[list]
[*]Linux - [b]DO NOT BUY YET.[/b] We are still working on why the levels will not load. [b]Plan to have a working build included in the next update.[/b]
[*]For some levels, the player ship is moving off screen. The enemies are very good at hide and seek and will still find you. [b]Still working on this feature.[/b]
[*]Unlocking levels is not very clear. Hovering over certain landmarks upon completing some levels will unlock other levels. We will be adding some visual queues at the end of those levels for assistance. [b]Still working on this feature.[/b]
[/list]
Upcoming:
[list]
[*]Achievements & Objectives - level and game wide challenges will be added with accompanying ship bonuses. 
[*]Ship Hangar - Ships will be earned and unlocked through achievements.
[*]Leaderboards - Compare scores with friends and enemies. 
[/list]

notes.title: DubWars v0.3.0 now available
notes.notes:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/7TaEFsK.png[/img]


[b]We are excited to bring a solid base foundation of DubWars to everyone.[/b] 
[list]
[*]All 10 levels are here to stay and feature Easy, Medium, and Hard Difficulties.
[*]New health system. 
[*]Urban Metaphor - New art and fixed the wasps dash movement issues.
[*]Synergy - Completely revamped. After attending EDC this year we wanted to bring a much more impressive stage design. 
[*]Break It Up - New art and gameplay. If you can beat easy please send a screen shot so we know it is possible.
[*]Eclipse - Jeffrey and Dillon are now in the level, but they have been captured and imprisoned within special asteroids. Rescuing them is your top priority, for bonus points…uh we mean for justice!
Revised the Zombie enemy, both art design and movement.
[*]Tough Guy - New art and gameplay. Improvements to enemy behavior. 
[*]Metalworks - New art, player weapons and gameplay. Improvements to enemy behavior. 
[*]Leviathan - New art and gameplay. 
[*]Distorted - Now playable. I hope you are not afraid of clowns…
[*]Choose Your Weapon - Now playable. Harness the power of 4 different elemental weapons. 
[*]MTRD - New art, player weapons and gameplay. 
[/list]
Known bugs:
[list]
[*]Linux - [b]DO NOT BUY YET.[/b] We are still working on why the levels will not load. Hang tight until we can get a solution working. The game is available on Mac and PC, you can play it on those platforms for now.
[*]When using a gamepad controller in the weapons upgrade screen, you are not able to scroll down to the additional selections. For now, you will need to use the mouse or keyboard.
[*]Break It Up - If you die and use Play Again and change teams, some of the enemies are not spawning correctly. If you exit to the main menu and re-enter the level, it will work properly.
[*]For some levels, the player ship is moving off screen. The enemies are very good at hide and seek and will still find you. 
[*]Unlocking levels is not very clear. Hovering over certain landmarks upon completing some levels will unlock other levels. We will be adding some visual queues at the end of those levels for assistance. 
[*]MTRD - One of the stream weapons upon upgrade decides to fire all instances of itself. Currently looking into the cause. 
[/list]
Upcoming:
[list]
[*]Achievements - level and game wide challenges will be added with accompanying ship bonuses. 
[*]Ship Hangar - Ships will be earned and unlocked through achievements.
[*]Leaderboards - Compare scores with friends and enemies. 
[/list]

notes.title: Upcoming Game Update On March 9th – An Apology – And Looking To The Future
notes.notes:
This update will include a new level, multiple bug fixes, effects improvements, some of the levels that we’ve all been waiting to come back, and much more. Below is the concept art for the new level that will be released.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/SxPpRJ0.jpg[/img]

Also, we’d like to make a formal apology for our poor communication and what some have interpreted as a lack of caring. We’re committed to change this from here on out. We love DubWars, and we are trying to make it amazing. 

We want you to know that your value to us as customers, fellow gamers, and music lovers is immeasurable; we are so grateful for your feedback and continued support. We’re a small team (6) and have experienced some serious setbacks along the way that weren’t shared publicly, there have been game updates that shouldn’t have been, well...released, and all-in-all reasons behind the “madness”. Fortunately, we’ve made it through and are back on track. 

Excuses aside, the team is working furiously to create something we can be proud of, and most importantly, something that you’ll love to play. We’re committed to DubWars, and we’re committed to you, thanks for believing in us. 

In short…exciting things are coming, sorry we sucked, and please forgive us; we’re going to make it up to you.

notes.title: Controller Functionality
notes.notes: Only Xbox 360 controllers are mapped, but both wired and wireless should work. For the time being, you will need to press ctrl + t or cmd + t after starting a level. If you want to switch back to mouse and keyboard use ctrl + m or cmd + m. Smoother accessibility for controller support and the addition of more types will be included with the next update.

notes.title: New Update is Live!
notes.notes:
Here is a rundown of the changes:

Whats new? Nearly everything! We have rebuilt the entire game from scratch. This has lead to improved game performance and a more manageable development process. This version showcases the new art direction for DubWars along with the change in gameplay. Enemy spawns are now scripted and will remain the same throughout each playthrough. Player scores are now directly comparable within each version. Xbox 360 controller support  is now available (others coming soon). 

Now that we have a solid core to work with, future updates will include the addition of the remaining 5 levels along with Boss modes. Difficulty modes have been temporarily removed as we recreate them. We appreciate all of your comments and suggestions and for participating in the DubWars Early Access program. 

[img]https://z-1-scontent-b.xx.fbcdn.net/hphotos-xap1/v/t1.0-9/10702075_287322634799087_1964452845987397250_n.jpg?oh=516a80053fa8043a6572118b4b6ae33d&oe=54C64FAD[/img]

notes.title: Whats Coming in the Next Update
notes.notes:
Here is a rundown of the upcoming changes. 

Linux support is on the way along with controller support. 

New art direction giving the levels more depth and room for gameplay options. 

Look at the new Urban Metaphor by Omnivore layout.

[img]https://scontent-b-dfw.xx.fbcdn.net/hphotos-xpf1/t1.0-9/10301055_247411585456859_1322755599307596195_n.jpg[/img]

The city has been overrun and is infested with a variety of cybernetic bugs. It is up to you to clear them out. 

Prepare to choose your allegiance in Break It Up by The Official Spock. 

[img]https://scontent-a-dfw.xx.fbcdn.net/hphotos-xpa1/t1.0-9/10462665_247411842123500_4610277224453697456_n.jpg[/img]

You will be able to choose defense of the space station or join the invasion team. 

Here is a glimpse of Tough Guy by Celldweller remixed by Tim Ismag. 

[img]https://fbcdn-sphotos-a-a.akamaihd.net/hphotos-ak-xpf1/t1.0-9/10423966_247411925456825_1561782984534215616_n.jpg[/img]

Take a trip down the rabbit hole as you must survive the 360 degree enemy onslaught. 


New gameplay style - instead of the chaotic random spawning we will be customizing the enemy spawns and keeping them the same for each play through. This will help us have more control over what enemies are available and tuned to the music.
